profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Propio
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with 6+ years of expertise in production cloud-native development, scalable data pipelines, and API platform architecture. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, deliver high-impact solutions, and ensure operational excellence for systems processing billions of requests monthly.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
– Redefined alarm and observability infrastructure for a high-throughput video platform serving ~6M calls per week, reducing false alarms and surfacing previously masked failure modes 
– Drove cross-team initiatives for PHI redaction strategy of sensitive call data - preventing storage and downstream exposure of sensitive info across API, historical records, and observability pipelines 
– Built a greenfield backend service, provisioning cloud infrastructure (AWS CDK) and implementing the core API and service layer to migrate a core voice communication system off a third-party vendor

positions.title: Owner / Superhost
positions.description:
- Renovated, launched, and actively manage a profitable short-term rental unit in a section of my home, demonstrating initiative in real estate development
 - Maintained Airbnb Superhost status for 8 consecutive quarters, with reviews averaging 4.97★
 - Hosted 350+ guests across over 150 completed reservations
 - Maintained 100% response rate and 0% cancellation rate

positions.title: Independent Developer
positions.description:
Took an intentional year break from corporate to build multiple production web projects end-to-end:
- Resume Revamped: resume builder with theming, export pipelines, and AI-assisted editing
- APizzaMichigan: interactive, map-driven React app with Supabase backend
- DuoCalculator: a Duolingo tool that calculates time-to-complete a course based on user pace and goals

Responsible for architecture, frontend, backend, auth, deployment, analytics, and iteration based on real users.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: My team owned an API platform for Amazon's Selling Partners and Developers that handled 120B+ calls each month. Its services and data pipelines handled authentication, authorization, and throttling.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: In my time on the team, I have worked extensively with Java, Python, and AWS services to implement scaling and alarming mechanisms for our team's API platform, build features into our push notification system, and lead a system revamp/migration of our usage metrics data pipeline.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Mcity is the University of Michigan's self-driving car test facility. I built a video processing pipeline that ran a custom trained computer vision algorithm to detect objects relevant to the researchers at the University of Michigan and Mcity's partner companies. This system utilized Python, the Darknet/YOLO framework, and Docker containers running on AWS infrastructure to deliver processed videos for furthering autonomous vehicle research.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Computer Vision · Autonomous Vehicles · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Dining Service Worker
positions.description: My responsibilities included communicating with students and dining hall managers, assisting in the preparation and plating of food, and helping to maintain the presentation of the Mosher-Jordan Dining Hall.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: I spent the summer working alongside and leading a team of 6 painters to ensure quality and efficient work. My specific responsibilities beyond painting involved reporting to the regional branch manager on our progress, coordinating movement between sites, and communicating with homeowners regarding the specifics of each project.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Engineering - BSE

projects.title: BuiltHere.city
projects.description: A map and feed for following permits and development projects in Ann Arbor and Detroit. It turns municipal records into searchable project updates and includes verification and community-submitted tips.

projects.title: Map Data Aggregation and Enhancement Pipeline
projects.description: The shared data-processing core for A Pizza Michigan, TacoBoutMichigan, and BuiltHere.city. Separate food and BuiltHere runtimes use product-specific adapters and plugins. Each product owns review and publishing.

organizations.name: Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) Department
organizations.description: During my time in undergrad, I was a student ambassador for the Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) department at the University of Michigan. My responsibilities included promoting and working at ECE recruitment and alumni events as well as serving as a resource for younger students thinking of pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering.

organizations.name: Student Branch of IEEE (Institute for Electrical and Electronics Engineers)
organizations.position: Vice President of Communications · Apr 2018 - May 2020
